name: JStarx Layer
notes: JStarx v2: faster start, lighter on memory and kinder to the SD card
Full-screen apps whose title bars curve around the Dynamic Island (JStarx apps and Firefox)
Hover the island to open it: Today and Memory tabs
Memory page in Settings: up to 12 GB usable (4 GB RAM + up to 8 GB swap), Free up now, Memory saver
Memory saver keeps only what is in use in RAM: idle apps and background services move to swap, half of the RAM stays free
Power modes: Low power, Power saver, Balanced, Performance and Extreme, plus fan control
Spark 1 runs Storm's own model, with a Faster answers option
Whole-system updates from GitHub, auto-repair with a boot safety net, wireless display casting
Settings, Star Store, AI Center, Claude, Firefox and 3 games
